nodes.description: Storage.State.balance.supply: global ESDS stake supply, mutated by incrementBalanceOf/decrementBalanceOf
Storage.State.balance.debt: total outstanding debt tracked by Comptroller
Storage.State.balance.bonded: total bonded stake used for bonding ratios and governance quorum
Storage.State.balance.staged: total staged (unbonded) ESDS held by the contract
Storage.State.balance.redeemable: pool available for coupon redemption
Storage.State.balance.coupons: total outstanding coupon liability
Storage.State.epoch.current: current epoch counter advanced by Bonding.step
Storage.State.accounts[account].balance: per-account bonded share balance
Storage.State.accounts[account].staged: per-account staged ESDS
Storage.State.accounts[account].coupons[epoch]: per-account coupon balances
Storage.State.accounts[owner].couponAllowances[spender]: coupon transfer allowances
Storage.State.accounts[account].lockedUntil: governance lock epoch controlling statusOf
Storage.State.candidates[candidate]: governance proposal state (start, period, approve, reject, votes)
Storage.State.epochs[epoch].coupons.outstanding: per-epoch outstanding coupons used by expiration logic
IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT storage slot read/written via assembly for the upgradeable proxy
msg.sender: external caller controlling every state-mutating entry point
block.timestamp: source of epoch timing, exposed through blockTimestamp()/epochTime()
Implementation.initialize(): initializer-guarded mint of ADVANCE_INCENTIVE to msg.sender
Implementation.advance(): incentivized entry point running Bonding.step, Regulator.step and Market.step
Bonding.step(): requires epochTime() > epoch(), snapshots bonded supply and increments epoch
Bonding.deposit(value): pulls ESDS from caller via transferFrom then increases staged balance
Bonding.withdraw(value): transfers ESDS to caller then decrements staged balance
Bonding.bond(value): converts staged ESDS into bonded shares, applying initial stake multiple
Bonding.unbond(value): converts bonded shares back into staged ESDS
Bonding.unbondUnderlying(value): converts an underlying ESDS amount into staged ESDS
Regulator.step(): reads oracle price and grows or shrinks supply
Regulator.oracleCapture(): external oracle price capture with bootstrapping and validity fallbacks
Regulator.growSupply(price): computes bounded delta and calls increaseSupply
Regulator.shrinkSupply(price): computes bounded delta and calls increaseDebt
Market.step(): expires prior epoch coupons and schedules current epoch coupon expiration
Market.expireCouponsForEpoch(epoch): eliminates outstanding coupons and may trigger supply increase
Market.purchaseCoupons(dollarAmount): burns caller ESDS debt and mints coupons including premium
Market.redeemCoupons(couponEpoch, couponAmount): burns coupons and transfers redeemable ESDS
Market.approveCoupons(spender, amount): sets coupon allowance for msg.sender
Market.transferCoupons(sender, recipient, epoch, amount): moves coupon balances and burns allowance
Govern.vote(candidate, vote): records or changes a governance vote and places a lock
Govern.commit(candidate): applies a successful candidate after quorum checks
Govern.emergencyCommit(candidate): applies a candidate using super-majority and emergency delay
Upgradeable.upgradeTo(newImplementation): sets implementation and delegatecalls initialize()
Upgradeable.setImplementation(newImplementation): validates contract code and sstores the slot
Comptroller.mintToAccount(account, amount): mints dollars to account and possibly increases debt
Comptroller.burnFromAccount(account, amount): pulls dollars from account, burns them and reduces debt
Comptroller.redeemToAccount(account, amount): transfers dollars out and decrements redeemable
Comptroller.increaseSupply(newSupply): true-ups redeemable pool, eliminates debt and pays bonded
Comptroller.decreaseDebt(amount): decrements total debt and runs balance check
Comptroller.increaseDebt(amount): increments total debt and resets debt to the ratio cap
Comptroller.balanceCheck(): reverts if contract dollar balance is less than bonded+staged+redeemable
Market.couponPremium(amount): view wrapper over Curve.calculateCouponPremium
External IDollar.transferFrom call pulling tokens from an arbitrary account
External IDollar.transfer call pushing tokens to an arbitrary account before state updates
External IDollar.mint call creating new supply
External IOracle.capture() call returning an untrusted price and validity flag
delegatecall of initialize() on the candidate implementation inside upgradeTo
uint256(-1) unlimited coupon allowance sentinel comparison in transferCoupons
block.timestamp sub/div/add arithmetic in epochTimeWithStrategy driving epoch gating
Curve.effectivePremium/curve pow and division arithmetic computing coupon premium
dollarAmount parameter of Market.purchaseCoupons
couponAmount parameter of Market.redeemCoupons
candidate address parameter of Governance vote/commit/emergencyCommit
vote enum parameter of Govern.vote
newImplementation address parameter of Upgradeable.upgradeTo
value parameter of Bonding.deposit/withdraw/bond/unbond entry points
debtRatio local computed in Curve.effectivePremium
newDebt local computed in Regulator.shrinkSupply
incentive local in the incentivized modifier of Implementation.advance
staged local computed in Bonding.unbond

edges.reason: deposit uses msg.sender as the account whose staged balance is credited
withdraw uses msg.sender as the account whose staged balance is debited
bond credits shares to msg.sender and takes msg.sender staged balance
unbond debits msg.sender bonded balance
unbondUnderlying debits msg.sender bonded balance
purchaseCoupons burns msg.sender dollars and mints coupons to msg.sender
redeemCoupons decrements msg.sender coupon balance and pays msg.sender
approveCoupons writes the allowance of msg.sender as owner
vote uses msg.sender bonded balance as voting weight and applies a lock
initialize mints the advance incentive to msg.sender
advance mints the advance incentive to msg.sender inside the incentivized modifier
Bonding.step gate epochTime() > epoch() depends on block.timestamp
block.timestamp flows into the epochTimeWithStrategy offset/period arithmetic
emergencyCommit checks epochTime() against epoch plus the emergency delay
advance emits and relies on block.timestamp for epoch progression
Bonding.step compares epochTime() with the current epoch derived from timestamp arithmetic
Market.step derives the expiration epoch by adding a constant to the timestamp-based epoch
dollarAmount parameter drives the burn amount in purchaseCoupons
dollarAmount reaches burnFromAccount as the amount pulled and burned
couponAmount parameter is the coupon balance decremented in redeemCoupons
couponAmount parameter flows into redeemToAccount as the payout amount
candidate parameter selects the governance proposal being voted on
vote enum parameter determines approve/reject counter updates
candidate parameter selects which proposal commit applies
candidate parameter selects which proposal emergencyCommit applies
newImplementation parameter becomes the delegatecall target and stored implementation
value parameter is the staged amount credited in deposit
value parameter determines minted bond shares in bond
incentive local is passed to mintToAccount for the caller reward
newDebt local is passed to increaseDebt when supply shrinks
debtRatio local feeds the Curve premium arithmetic
staged local is the amount credited to the account in unbond
advance invokes Bonding.step first
advance invokes Regulator.step after bonding
advance invokes Market.step last
Market.step iterates and expires coupons for prior epochs
Regulator.step calls growSupply when price is above one
Regulator.step calls shrinkSupply when price is below one
Regulator.step obtains its price from oracleCapture
expireCouponsForEpoch calls increaseSupply with the excess redeemable
purchaseCoupons burns the caller dollars through burnFromAccount
redeemCoupons pays the caller through redeemToAccount
commit upgrades the proxy to the approved implementation
emergencyCommit upgrades the proxy to the approved implementation
upgradeTo stores the implementation through setImplementation
initialize mints the advance incentive via mintToAccount
increaseSupply calls decreaseDebt to retire debt with new supply
increaseDebt validates solvency with balanceCheck
decreaseDebt validates solvency with balanceCheck
increaseSupply ends with a balanceCheck
mintToAccount ends with a balanceCheck
burnFromAccount ends with a balanceCheck
redeemToAccount ends with a balanceCheck
couponPremium delegates into the Curve premium arithmetic
shrinkSupply increases debt by the bounded delta
growSupply mints new supply through increaseSupply
burnFromAccount pulls tokens with the external transferFrom call
deposit pulls tokens from the caller using the external transferFrom call
withdraw sends tokens with the external transfer call before updating staged state
redeemToAccount sends tokens with the external transfer call
mintToAccount creates new dollar supply with the external mint call
oracleCapture consumes the untrusted oracle price returned by the external capture call
upgradeTo executes delegatecall into the candidate implementation
transferCoupons compares the allowance against the uint256(-1) sentinel before spending
the external token transfer can re-enter withdraw before the staged balance is decremented
the external token transferFrom can re-enter deposit before the staged balance is incremented
the delegatecall executes initialize() on the newly installed implementation

normalization_plan.reason: dollarAmount is only meaningful as the input amount of purchaseCoupons
couponAmount is only meaningful as the redeemed amount of redeemCoupons
candidate is the proposal selector passed into Govern.vote
vote is the enum argument that drives counter updates inside Govern.vote
newImplementation exists solely to be installed and delegatecalled by upgradeTo
value is the generic staged-amount argument of the bonding deposit entry point
debtRatio is an intermediate of the Curve premium computation
newDebt is the intermediate value handed to increaseDebt by shrinkSupply
incentive is the reward amount passed to mintToAccount by the incentivized modifier
staged is the intermediate credited inside Bonding.unbond
